page.overview:
Who is Berdzerd?

"Wizard City" (Distant Lands)|age=Deceased|occup=Magical Arts Teacher Member of the Cult of Coconteppi}} Berdzerd is a minor character in "Thanks for the Crabapples, Giuseppe". He does a "secret wizard handshake" with another wizard named Chinchizard. The two appear to be part of a secret wizard society, though they tend to openly brag about their secret handshake and secret meetings to make other wizards such as Abracadaniel feel excluded. Berdzerd is also able to fly by flapping his wing-arms.

He returns in "Wizard City", as the Astral Projection Professor in Magical Arts. He finally revealed himself as a member of the Coconteppi cult. When Pepperminteppi begins killing the cult members, Berdzerd tries to stop him with his astral projection, only to be killed when Peppermanteppi crushes his projection, causing his physical body to turn to dust.

Berdzerd has pale yellow skin. His cheeks appear to be pink. He wears a dark blue wizard robe with a light blue outline. He has a stock like thing on his head as well.
